method: Native iOS simulator WebRTC to the production GPT-Live endpoint via a local SRTP forwarding relay. Identical generated 48 kHz PCM sentence, real-time pacing, one utterance per session. Relay never decrypts audio.

runs.profile: isolated: every tenth RTP packet starting at packet 80

limitations: One sentence and one measured run per condition: not a statistical quality benchmark.
The existing Opus path was measured; no claim that the new disconnect grace improves word accuracy.
Codec recovery cannot be inferred from transcript accuracy alone; decoder concealment and model context can also help.
An initial loopback-candidate proxy failure was excluded; successful runs assert more than 250 audio RTP packets traversed the relay.
implemented: Temporary ICE disconnection gets a bounded five-second recovery window instead of immediate call teardown. Recovery does not restore missing audio.
next_candidate: Benchmark authenticated TURN over TLS/TCP for the phone-to-relay hop, retaining WebRTC voice processing. Relay-to-provider UDP can still lose packets, and TCP retransmission can add head-of-line delay. Do not replace the default before comparing latency and word accuracy.
